message:
You know that friend who always seems to panic at the slightest hint of trouble? Well, I like to think of myself as the calmer counterpart. I’ve found that being prepared can really help ease that anxiety, and I came across a lovely resource from the Red Cross that breaks down what you might want in a survival kit. 

It’s practical, straightforward, and makes you feel just a little more in control. I’m all for having a little peace of mind tucked away in a corner. After all, isn’t it better to be ready for anything, even if we hope we never have to use it? What’s in your emergency kit?
